title: The Andes Mountains
text: The Andes are the longest continental mountain range in the world, stretching approximately 7,000 km along the western coast of South America through seven countries: Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Argentina, and Chile. The highest peak is Aconcagua at 6,961 meters, located in Argentina and the highest point outside of Asia. The Andes are geologically active, with numerous volcanoes including Cotopaxi in Ecuador. They are the source of many major rivers including the Amazon's headwaters and the Río de la Plata. Andean civilizations, particularly the Inca Empire, developed some of history's most remarkable agricultural and engineering achievements, including terraced farming and an extensive road network.
